snippet.title: Closed Beta Test on July 24th // Closed Beta Trailer - Fate Trigger
snippet.description:
Finger on the Trigger – Anime Hyper-Tactical Heroes are Storming the Arena!
- Wishlist and join our Closed Beta on Steam at https://bit.ly/4nCgQUv 
- Join CBT events on the official website to get test access at https://bit.ly/4lusJuc
- Join our official Discord at https://discord.gg/fatetrigger

Fate Trigger is an Anime Hyper-Tactical Hero Shooter. Ready to flex your tactics? Scavenge, craft epic gear, and unleash special skills to outgun and outsmart your rivals!

*Socials
Twitter: https://x.com/FateTrigger_EN
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FateTrigger
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fatetrigger_eng/

*It is Beta footage, not the final version

#FateTrigger #FateTriggerCBT #HeroShooter #AnnouncementTrailer
